FINDINGS:
Lungs: Bilateral pulmonary nodules measuring up to 8 mm.
Heart: Mild cardiomegaly.
Mediastinum: Enlarged mediastinal lymph nodes.
Pleura: Small bilateral pleural effusions.
Chest wall: Normal.

IMPRESSION:
1. Bilateral pulmonary nodules.
2. Mild cardiomegaly.
3. Mediastinal lymphadenopathy.
